note: Daily resume 2026-11-03 (P3254) leads from the needs-info sweep. Runtime/driver changes on master wait for the publish-hold bisect P3095; written in our own words, links only.

leads.symptom: PIR+lux sensor (ZG-204ZL family) keeps the same lux value until a motion event (forum 140352 #761, #828).
leads.finding: ZHA quirk 'TuyaZG-204ZL' (tuya_motion.py, builder for _TZE200_3towulqd, also _TZE200_1ibpyhdc/_TZE200_bh3n6gk8/_TZE200_ttcovulf) maps DP1 occupancy with 0 = occupied, DP4 battery, DP9 sensitivity, DP10 fading time, DP12 illuminance and DP105 illuminance_interval (writable number). Our EnrichedDPMappings ZG_204ZL profile has DP12 lux but no DP105 interval setting, and DeviceFingerprintDB lists DP104 as lux for this couple.
leads.proposal: Additive: expose DP105 illuminance_interval as an optional device setting for this exact couple only; verify the DP1 polarity against a live frame before changing anything (observe, do not assume). Never mandatory, no new capability.

leads.symptom: Battery curtain robot (3xAA, lux sensor) stops half way, battery and lux stay empty, no travel-limit option (forum 140352 #778, #792).
leads.finding: Z2M 'TS030F' (Smart blind controller) exposes cover position + calibration time only, no battery or illuminance, so the battery/lux robot is probably a different exact couple. Do not move or add anything until the exact mfr+pid of the robot is known (interview or diag with fingerprint).
